description: Seven logic gates in one module: AND, NAND, OR, NOR, XOR, XNOR and NOT

inputs.text: A gate signal into the AND gate, normalled to the other AND input so the gate works with one cable patched
The second gate signal into the AND gate
A gate signal into the OR gate, with the NAND output normalled here
The second gate signal into the OR gate
A gate signal into the XOR gate
The second gate signal into the XOR gate, with the NOR output normalled here
The gate signal that the NOT gate inverts, with the XOR output normalled here

outputs.text: High while both AND inputs are high
The inverse of the AND gate, low only while both AND inputs are high, and normalled to the first OR input
High while either OR input is high
The inverse of the OR gate, high only while both OR inputs are low, and normalled to the second XOR input
High while one XOR input is high and the other is low, and normalled to the NOT input
The inverse of the XOR gate, high while both XOR inputs match
The inverse of the NOT input, high while that input is low
